var reads = 0;
Future<bool> include(int index) async {
  reads++;
  return index < 4;
}

Future<void> main() async {
  final rows = [for (var index = 0; await include(index); index++) index];
  if (reads != 5 || rows.join(',') != '0,1,2,3') throw StateError('$reads $rows');
  print('reads=$reads, rows=$rows');
}
